attacks.name: Heavy Repulsor Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, if it did not deal |!damage|, this character gains 1 |!power|.
After this attack is resolved, Push the defender Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Meteor Punch
steps: The defender does not gain |!power| for |!damage| dealt by this attack.
After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage| and the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!range_medium|.
|!wild| |*Explosive|: Before |!damage| is dealt, other enemy characters within |!range| 2 of the defender suffer 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Hit and Run
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes an attack action followed by a move action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Now I‘m Mad
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 4 or less within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Built to Take It
superPowers.body: When this character would be Pushed or Thrown, it may use this superpower. This character is not Pushed or Thrown.

superPowers.name: Hulk-Scale Armor
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1. Additionally, during the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

superPowers.name: Enhanced Support Systems [Iron Man (Hulkbuster)]
superPowers.body: If this character would flip its Stat Card to the Injured side, Place |*Iron Man (Hulkbuster)| within |!range| 2 of it, then remove this character from the battlefield. |*Iron Man (Hulkbuster)| has no |!damage|, |!power|, special conditions, or effects and is now part of your Squad.

attacks.name: Rapid Repulsor Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, Push it Away |!range_small|.

|!wild| |*Rapid Fire|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Rapid Repulsor Blast| attack. The additional attack must target the original defender and does not have the |*Rapid Fire| special rule.

superPowers.name: Always Have a Backup
superPowers.body: Place a |*Hulkbuster| character within |!range| 1 of this character. It has no |!damage|, |!power|, special conditions, or effects. That |*Hulkbuster| gains an Activated token. It is now part of your Squad. Remove this character from the Game.

superPowers.name: New Plan
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, if this character was damaged by the attack, it may use this superpower. This character Advances |!range_medium|.

superPowers.name: Agile Armor
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack or making a dodge roll, it may reroll up to 2 of its defense or dodge dice.

superPowers.name: Secondary Support Suit
superPowers.body: When this character would be Dazed, it is KO'd instead.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 13 to 14 on Hulkbuster, increased from 5 to 6 on Iron Man (Hulkbuster).

Leaderhip ability removed. It read "When an allied character would suffer |!damage| from a collision, reduce the amount suffered by 1.|\|If your squad is using the |*Hulkbusters| Leadership ability, when this character is put into play you are still using this Leadership ability."

Built to Take It superpower's power cost increased from 1 to 2 and reworked. It previously reduced the amount of |!damage| dealt by 1 and prevented to be pushed as a result of special rules during the defended attack.
Agile Armor innate superpower added to Iron Man (Hulkbuster).
Hulk-Scale Armor innate superpower added to Hulkbuster. The Additional power during the Power Phase was previously part of the Enhanced Support Systems superpower.
Reserve keyword added to Iron Man (Hulkbuster). Its effect was previously part of the Secondary Support Suit superpower.
